maris: Quick note from onboarding: ptq-reranker-v6 shows seed-sensitive NDCG swings on holdout-G, suspect retrieval nondeterminism + quant sensitivity. Dumping short repro.

teo: Numbers?

maris: fp16 NDCG@10=0.451; ptq mean=0.427 across 4 seeds. Per-seed NDCG: [0.432,0.421,0.435,0.420]. MRR deltas ~0.016.

eva: Do candidates differ across seeds or just ordering?

maris: Both. With live retrieval topk varies ~80-85% overlap across seeds; with snapshot topk overlap ~96% and ndcg stdev drops to 0.003. So retrieval nondet is main driver, quant widens impact.

sam: Actionable: (1) run a 6-seed fingerprint sweep with snapshot retrieval + ptq scoring and emit per-query topk sha1 and score stdev; (2) run layer-ablations (early/mid/tail int8) with snapshot to localize scoring noise; (3) default onboarding to use snapshot+fingerprinting.

infra-bot: Snapshot written: s3://redwood-eval/holdoutG/snapshots/2026-03-23/snap-3087654321. Flag --deterministic-retrieval available.

eva: I'll own the fingerprint sweep and alert rule. Proposed alert: rerank-ptq-topk-jitter -> trigger when rel NDCG drop >2% AND mean topk Jaccard <0.87 across two runs.

maris: Uploading artifacts and a tiny repro script to the run folder now; tagging @teo @eva @sam for visibility.
